name: RBMOBJ1

header.allLengths: exact bounded integers, not allocation sizes; compare registered object metadata and admitted resource policy before decode

keyDerivation.info: ASCII RBMOBJ1-KEY\0 || nativeAccountId16 || immutableObjectId16 || purposeU16 || versionU16
keyDerivation.rule: new random immutable objectId for EVERY new representation; never reuse objectId/key+nonce for recompression/overwrite. Dedup reuses immutable existing bytes only.

frames.nonce: eight zero bytes || frameIndexU32 big endian, safe only under unique derived immutable object key
frames.aad: ASCII RBMOBJ1-AAD\0 || exact full header124 || frameIndexU32 || framePlainLengthU32
frames.wire: ciphertextAndTagLengthU32 || ciphertext || tag16; nonce derived, not stored
frames.count: exact header count, strict sequence from0; empty content still one zero-plaintext authenticated frame
frames.limits: plain frame<=32768, ciphertext size=plain+16, no trailing bytes/duplicate/missing/reordered frames; overall expected stored length checked

writeOrder: receive/hash/compress exact admitted plaintext into owned private staging, record final lengths/digest
build fixed header, choose new immutable objectId, derive object key
encrypt bounded frames; publish owned object or inline final blob only after all frames written/validated
commit DB refs/cursor under current epoch/account/fence recheck
never expose unfinished staged object as valid message
readOrder: validate fixed header/version/purpose/account/epoch/object identity and bounds against native catalog
derive key using registered account key version, not arbitrary caller key
authenticate each complete frame BEFORE giving decrypted compressed bytes to bounded inflater
verify total original length and digest before final successful read/export result
on any failure mark object corrupt/unavailable, retain other messages, do not auto delete whole account
privacyLimits: metadata/Gecko profile and temporary staging may rely on Android app-private/FBE rather than application AEAD; do not claim whole-install crypto erase
private staging included exact epoch erasure/GC ownership manifest
selective encryption is not authentication or a substitute for source guard
ordinary UI browsing does not require repeated Android biometric prompts
testsRequired: bomb/length bounds, missing key version, no silent clear
Android Keystore/JCA actual Release throughput and restoration
